scripts.mobile:sync: pnpm mobile:prepare && pnpm exec cap sync android && CAP_PLATFORM=ios pnpm exec cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:icons: mkdir -p src/mobile/resources && cp icon.png src/mobile/resources/icon.png && npx capacitor-assets generate --assetPath src/mobile/resources --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#10100e' --splashBackgroundColor '#10100e' && node Android/scripts/store-assets.cjs
scripts.android:release: pnpm android:sync && cd Android && ./gradlew assembleDebug bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: pnpm mobile:prepare && CAP_PLATFORM=ios pnpm exec cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='' build
scripts.android:sync: pnpm mobile:prepare && pnpm exec cap sync android
